title: Chapter 177 Power Merger
content:
Chapter 177 Power Merger

Leave together.

Hearing Yan Lingyun's words, the ministers did not hesitate at all.

"We wait, and I wish to follow Your Majesty to the death!"

Looking at the firm gazes of the ministers, Yan Lingyun also smiled.

"But I'll agree first. If you want to leave with this emperor, you must join the Huangcheng. I think you should be able to understand what I mean."

As soon as these words came out, everyone below was stunned.

Join the deserted city?

The rumors are actually true!

The Divine Dynasty is really going to be incorporated into the deserted city.

Suddenly, a complex emotion arose from everyone's hearts.

Because this is their belief, Yan Lingyun, the empress of the Divine Dynasty, said it personally, which made them unable to even say a word of refutation.

Seeing everyone feeling a little depressed, Yan Lingyun pursed her lips and sighed in her heart.

This matter was carefully considered by her.

The original intention of establishing the Divine Dynasty was to have enough power to fight against the enemies of the Spirit-Devouring Clan and unknown star fields.

And now, this world has a stronger guardian.

That is the deserted city.

More importantly, the master of Huangcheng is his own man.

I am absolutely relieved.

Although Huangcheng has a good relationship with the Divine Dynasty, we can help each other.

But Yan Lingyun understood that this was only temporary.

With the development speed of Huangcheng, it won’t take long to survive, Huangcheng’s strength will be far superior to that of the Divine Dynasty.

At that time, even if the Divine Dynasty did not merge into the deserted city, it would have no meaning.

Since this is the case, it is better to merge early. In this way, these people can still enjoy the quality treatment of the Huangcheng in advance.

"Have you considered it clearly?"

At this time, the god below stood up.

"Your Majesty, will you stay in the deserted city?"

God looked at Yan Lingyun and said in a straight voice.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun nodded, "Natural."

As long as there is Lu Daosheng in Huangcheng, she will stay in Huangcheng forever.

Hearing this, God no longer hesitated.

"Your Majesty, I would like to accompany you."

"good."

Looking at Shen Yi, Yan Lingyun smiled.

Seeing that General Shenyi agreed, the rest of the people no longer hesitated.

"Your Majesty, I wish."

"Your Majesty, I'm there."

Suddenly, everyone in the entire hall was willing to be with Yan Lingyun.

Although the Divine Dynasty is gone in a sense.

But as long as Yan Lingyun is still there, they will still have faith.

"Since that's the case, let me inform you about this matter. I'll give you a month to prepare. In a month, I will return to the wasteland city."

......

After the meeting, everyone left the hall one after another.

"Miss Mu Yu, wait for me!"

At this time, Gu Chen chased Mu Yu.

However, Mu Yu's pace did not stop at all, but instead accelerated his speed a little.

Seeing this, Gu Chen was a little anxious.

Just as he was about to rush over, a figure suddenly blocked in front of him.

"Gu Chen, what do you want to do?"

Jian Xin looked at Gu Chen and said coldly.

"Miss Jianxin, please let me know. I have something to do with Miss Mu Yu."

Seeing that it was Jian Xin, Gu Chen's face calmed down a little.

However, Jian Xin did not move and just stood in front of Gu Chen.

"Gu Chen, you have hurt Mu Yu once, and now you are here to look for Mu Yu again. Are you interested?"

Jian Xin stared at Gu Chen.

Hearing this, Gu Chen's face was a little unnatural.

He also knew that he was in the wrong, so he didn't dare to say anything harsh.

"Miss Jianxin, it was an accident last time. I came to find Mu Yu this time to apologize to her."

When Jian Xin heard Gu Chen say apologize, his expression moved slightly.

Seeing this, Gu Chen hurriedly continued, "Miss Jianxin, please believe me. This time, I will never let Mu Yu be sad again."

Upon hearing this, Jian Xin stared at Gu Chen for a long time and said slowly, "You'd better be."

Immediately, Jian Xin left.

Standing there, Gu Chen breathed a sigh of relief and hurriedly chased after him.

"Miss Mu Yu, wait for me!"

Movement came from behind again, and Mu Yu frowned slightly.

Just as he was about to speed up, Gu Chen's figure was already blocking her.

"Miss Mu Yu,"

Looking at Mu Yu in front of him, Gu Chen's gaze suddenly softened.

"You get out of the way."

Mu Yu's face was cold.

However, Gu Chen remained motionless, "Mu Yu, listen to my explanation. There was a misunderstanding about that matter at that time."

"You don't have to explain, there is nothing between me and you."

Mu Yu said in a quiet voice, and then directly bypassed Gu Chen.

But at this time, Gu Chen grabbed Mu Yu's hand.

Soft as boneless.

Suddenly, Mu Yu's delicate body trembled slightly.

"You, let go."

A blush appeared on Mu Yu's little face, looking extremely attractive.

However, Gu Chen was very tight and had no intention of letting go.

"Mu Yu, I won't let go."

"You, will you let it go?"

At this time, someone had noticed this, which made Mu Yu's face even redder.

But Gu Chen's strength was too great, no matter how she broke free, she could not pull out her hands.

"Don't let it go."

Gu Chen said firmly.

Seeing this, Mu Yu nodded, "Okay, this is what you asked for."

I saw Mu Yu raised the staff in his hand high and then knocked directly on Gu Chen's forehead.

Bang!

The sound is crisp.

Gu Chen was stunned in the spot.

"Fuck."

Then, Gu Chen's eyes went dark, and he lost his balance and fell down.

"You,"

At this moment, Mu Yu stared at Gu Chen who fell in her arms with anger. She suspected that this guy was not fainted at all, but was doing it on purpose.

And at this moment, Mu Yu suddenly found that there was no one around.

"Huh? What's going on?"

There were obviously many people around just now.

Looking down at Gu Chen, Mu Yu's face was a little ugly. Did she hit him too hard?

Is it okay to leave him here?

Looking around at the empty streets around, Mu Yu was silent.

After a long time.

Mu Yu carried Gu Chen back to her mansion.

Because she often studied various magic arts and was used to being quiet, she was the only one in the whole mansion.

With a bang.

Mu Yu threw Gu Chen directly on her bed.

Looking at Gu Chen who had lost consciousness, Mu Yu punched the air in anger.

"You damn stinky man!"

I don't know how long it took.

The next day.

"Hiss~ah, my head hurts."

Gu Chen woke up faintly and smelled a familiar fragrance.

Then, Gu Chen got up suddenly and found that he was lying in a strange place.

"Where is this?"

Gu Chen looked puzzled.

At this time, the fragrance came again, and Gu Chen suddenly remembered.

This is Mu Yu's breath.

Thinking of what happened before he fainted, so this is, Mu Yu's boudoir? ?

With a bang.

Gu Chen got up and walked outside, and began to look for his target in this huge mansion.

Not long after, in a small courtyard, Gu Chen saw a woman holding a magic wand and carving something in the courtyard.
